mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC rebounded from -30.7 at t-1w to -26.9 at t-0w, a four-point week-on-week improvract. If this momentum persists it should carry forward, pushing the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean above the last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved from -30.7 to -26.9 over the last week
failure_condition: If the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is lower than the last 28-day mean despite the observed t-0w uptick, the momentum-persistence mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT mobility falls below -35 percent from baseline, commuters and shoppers curtail discretionary trips to retail districts due to perceived infection risk or reduced access, suppressing RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -35 points from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT reached -37.7 at t-2w and -35.0 at t-1w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even while TRANSIT remains below -35, the transit-suppression mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility above +10 percent indicates continued state-of-emergency-style stay-home guidance is still being followed, which will keep RETAIL_REC suppressed relative to the prior period over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed between 10.9 and 12.7 across all four weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above +10, the stay-home-policy suppression mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous recovery in PARKS and WORKPLACES mobility signals broader normalization of both leisure and work routines; when both series improve together week-on-week, retail footfall rises in tandem as combined errand-and-commute chains resume, lifting RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -31.1 to -23.4 and WORKPLACES held steady at -21.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 14 days despite concurrent week-on-week improvement in both PARKS and WORKPLACES, the joint-recovery mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Early-to-mid March marks the seasonal transition toward warmer weather and cherry blossom season in Tokyo, which historically increases outdoor park visits and associated nearby retail and dining footfall, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:decision date is 2021-03-15, within the seasonal window preceding hanami season
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days despite the seasonal timing and any accompanying PARKS increase, the seasonal-uplift mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp week-on-week drop in GROCERY_PHARM mobility exceeding 5 points signals tightening caution or renewed restriction announcements that precede a broader pullback in discretionary retail visits within one week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls more than 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM dropped from -4.3 at t-2w to -7.4 at t-1w, a 3.1 point fall
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not decline within the following week after a greater-than-5-point GROCERY_PHARM drop, the leading-indicator mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mobility move together because commuting drives both; when TRANSIT rebounds while WORKPLACES stays flat, it indicates increased non-commute travel (e.g., shopping trips), which raises RETAIL_REC within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -35.0 to -32.9 while WORKPLACES stayed at -21.9 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not rise within one week when TRANSIT improves while WORKPLACES remains flat, the decoupled-transit mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Under a regime of continued emergency-style guidance, the combination of low TRANSIT (below -30) and high RESIDENTIAL (above +10) indicates compliance with movement restrictions is still strong, which will keep RETAIL_REC suppressed below its recent baseline over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT below -30 and RESIDENTIAL above +10 simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT ranged -32.9 to -37.7 and RESIDENTIAL ranged 10.9 to 12.7 across all four weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite TRANSIT remaining below -30 and RESIDENTIAL above +10 throughout, the compliance-suppression mechanism is rejected.
